meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,助理能通过 Signal 收发消息:用你现有手机号作为辅助设备接入,不注册新号码,可处理私聊、群聊和发给自己的消息,并带 Markdown 格式与引用回复。
howto.when: 当你在设置流程中要求接入 Signal,或想让现有 Signal 号码直接被助理收发消息时触发。

say.text: 把 NanoClaw 连到我的 Signal 账号
say.note: 会生成链接和二维码,用手机扫码完成绑定。

say.text: 帮 Signal 群聊建一个独立会话
say.note: 会给该群单独 wiring 一个 agent 会话。

say.text: Signal 频道好像没回应,查一下
say.note: 会检查适配器、账号绑定和服务进程。

howto.what_en: After installation, the assistant can send and receive Signal messages: it links as a secondary device using your existing phone number, no new number registered, and handles DMs, group chats, and Note-to-Self with Markdown formatting and quote replies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Signal during setup, or want the assistant to use your existing Signal number for messaging.

say_en.text: Link NanoClaw to my Signal account.
say_en.note: Generates a link and QR code to scan from your phone.

say_en.text: Give the Signal group chat its own session.
say_en.note: Creates a separate wiring for that group.

say_en.text: Check why my Signal channel isn't responding.
say_en.note: Inspects adapter, account binding, and service process.
